GATEWAY_BASE_URL.title: Gateway base URL
GATEWAY_BASE_URL.description: HTTPS base URL of your organization's Agent Governance MCP gateway (scheme + host only; no path). Defaults to https://mcp.dev.myelin-internal.com. Do not append /mcp/... — the plugin adds that.
